### Bricks Without Straw
Author: One Year Devotions for Men
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/bricks-without-straw-one-year-devotions-for-men-may-17.html
Passage: Exodus 5:7-8
Points:
- Oppression intensified when Pharaoh forced the Israelites to gather their own straw while demanding the exact same quota of bricks.
- Heavy suffering led the people and Moses to question why God allowed circumstances to grow worse.
- Hidden behind painful trials, God was actively preparing to reveal His supreme lordship.
- Even when evil seems dominant and the innocent suffer, believers can remain confident that God will ultimately prevail.
